connectorUiConfig.title: 1Falcon CCF Checkpoint Test
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The **1Falcon** connector is a throwaway test harness used to observe how the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) computes query time boundaries and applies `initialCheckpointTimeUtc`. It defines two connections against a Mock REST Bin endpoint: one using a paired `_QueryWindowStartTime`/`_QueryWindowEndTime` query, and one using a single open-ended `since` start-time parameter. Point both at the same Mock REST Bin (different sub-paths) and inspect the bin's Request Monitor to see exactly what values CCF sends on the first poll and on subsequent polls.

dataTypes.name: OneFalconPaired_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
OneFalconPaired_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: OneFalconOpenEnded_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
OneFalconOpenEnded_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
union isfuzzy=true OneFalconPaired_CL, OneFalconOpenEnded_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(1d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions on the Log Analytics workspace are required.

customs.name: Mock REST Bin
customs.description: Create a Mock REST Bin (mock-rest-bin.victorioussky-cbe548e7.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io) with response scenarios for the /paired and /openended paths before configuring this connector. Note the bin expires roughly an hour after creation, so create it right before you connect.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 1 - Create the Mock REST Bin
instructionSteps.description: Create a REST API Server bin at https://mock-rest-bin.victorioussky-cbe548e7.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io/ with two conditional response scenarios: one matching URL path `/paired`, one matching `/openended`. Both should check the `x-functions-key` header equals your chosen test key and return a 200 JSON body like `{"events": []}`. Note the bin's base endpoint URL, for example `https://mock-rest-bin.victorioussky-cbe548e7.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io/api/bins/<binId>`.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 2 - Connect to the Mock REST Bin
instructionSteps.description: Enter the Mock REST Bin base URL and the test API key, then click **Connect**.
